dimensional_hold.gate: Supply a reconciled drawing or explicitly authored dimensional specification and revision before a fabrication/folding candidate can pass. Choosing either printed value alone does not resolve the conflict.

source_conflicts.affected: Exact source-matched specimen geometry and fabrication qualification.
source_conflicts.resolution_gate: Preserve both readings; require a reconciled drawing or explicitly authored dimensional specification before fabrication.
Keep both derivation paths and an unresolved model-validation flag; do not silently implement the adjustment as a proven general rule.
Require convention-aware mathematical review before any numeric shear acceptance rule; retain qualitative observations independently.
Require a verified design specification; do not automatically choose a version.

source_conflicts.affected: Model scaling and comparison across specimen sizes.
source_conflicts.resolution_gate: Document a dimensional convention and independently validate it before reuse.
Treat these as unresolved notation warnings; do not repair the source silently or claim a verified implementation.
Resolve and document correspondence before comparing processed source files with final published measurements.
Require convention-aware mathematical review; no silent sign repair.
Retain both source readings; verify approved pattern/model correspondence before implementation.
Do not infer or apply a corrected formula in this design; independent model reconciliation required.

guard_invariants: Unknown drawing, qualification, fold plan, limits, or evidence cannot be replaced with nominal visual geometry.
A fabrication receipt does not imply R06 inspection or any per-edge folding completion.
Every supplied dependency-ordered edge requires its own observed pre/post result; latest failed results remain a hold.
Mounted, loaded, unknown-load, unsupported, or tool-engaged specimens cannot be transported.
Calibration is invalidated by any camera, lens, camera mount/configuration, fixture or reference revision change.
Each image hash must equal its own original-file receipt; front/lateral camera roles and camera IDs are distinct, and image hashes differ.
Paired captures share campaign/session/specimen/configuration/lock interval/token/calibration with current camera, fixture and reference revisions.
A qualitative load still requires a known, bounded, externally qualified magnitude; visual agreement cannot supply missing load parameters.
R19 explicit supported load removal and token invalidation precede detachment; R22 applies only to corner mounts and R30 only to rigid mounts.
Corner release additionally accounts for terminal load job and load hardware; every release accounts for each attachment and exact lease.
Baseline, rest, edge, damage and event histories are append-only; later unchanged observations cannot erase prior damage.
Closeout requires closed leases, empty stations, exact tool inventory, no residual loads and reconciled storage/quarantine custody.
Explicit support, carrier retention, inventory and stability booleans must be literal true; strings or numeric truthy values cannot grant a transition.
Mount attachments and corner load-job IDs must be nonempty typed identities. Two camera assemblies cannot share a physical lens identity.
R15 quantitative tokens and R18 paired records require the polypropylene rigid-metrology fixture kind; corner and rigid-demo mounts are excluded.

Prepared specimens retain dimensional specification revision, basis, numeric value, drawing revision, per-edge plan and qualification evidence identity; subsequent edge records cannot silently substitute any of them.
Unknown lease, occupancy or tool inventories are distinct from explicitly empty inventories.

R13 configuration candidates require the PP specimen family and rigid_metrology fixture kind; CS1-CS4 rigid_demo/corner memberships cannot invoke R13, R15 tokens or R18 pairs. R27 remains metadata-only and unimplemented.

actor_export.warning: Projection is a static allowlist example, not runtime isolation. Do not mount states.json, tests, review input files, or the semantic-control implementation into an actor environment.

api_boundary.side_effects: none; in-memory immutable candidate records only
api_boundary.time: caller-supplied logical ticks; no clock I/O
api_boundary.hashes: validates supplied strings against supplied receipts; reads no image files and cannot authenticate image quality or byte integrity
api_boundary.input_trust: caller-supplied synthetic records, not signed or trusted evidence
api_boundary.qualification: boolean/string presence is checked only as an example; independent evidence authentication and actual qualification remain unimplemented
api_boundary.geometry: No collision, reachability, force, torque, clearance, friction, hinge, material, or camera simulation is performed.

verification.scope: Static synthetic consistency and rejection tests only; passing tests are not physical validation.
